title: AI for Everyone
subtitle: 12 weeks · 48 sessions · 96 hours
summary: Practical AI skills for every profession.

levels: Ready to use as it is
Checked everything that matters, explains how
Safe, and explains the risks avoided

stages.title: Month 1 — Foundations
stages.goal: Learn to Speak to AI · Weeks 1–4

items.title: D1 — What AI actually is — demystifying LLMs; how they work in plain language
items.detail: Outcome: I can explain in plain words what an AI chatbot does and does not do

items.title: D2 — Tokens, prediction, and why answers vary — the “why” behind AI’s behaviour
items.detail: Outcome: I can show the same prompt giving different answers and explain why

items.title: D3 — Hands-on setup — accounts on ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini, secured with two-step verification
items.detail: Outcome: I can sign in to three assistants on their own device, with accounts secured

items.title: D4 — First real conversation — comparing the three tools on a task from your own work
items.detail: Outcome: I can compare three tools on one real task and choose one, giving a reason

items.title: D1 — The RCTF formula — Role, Context, Task, Format
items.detail: Outcome: I can write a prompt that contains all four RCTF parts

items.title: D2 — RCTF applied to your profession — guided practice
items.detail: Outcome: I can rewrite three of their own work tasks as RCTF prompts

items.title: D3 — The five layers of context — identity, world, task, examples, constraints
items.detail: Outcome: I can add the five layers to a weak prompt and show the better result

items.title: D4 — Workshop — combining RCTF and context layers into a strong prompt
items.detail: Outcome: I can produce one strong prompt for a real weekly task

items.title: D1 — Iteration and follow-ups — treating AI as a conversation, not a one-shot query
items.detail: Outcome: I can improve an answer through three follow-ups instead of starting again

items.title: D2 — Structured Markdown prompting — Role, Objective, Context, Instructions, Notes
items.detail: Outcome: I can write a structured Markdown prompt for a multi-part task

items.title: D3 — Reasoning vs. instant models — when to use which
items.detail: Outcome: I can choose the right model type for five sample tasks and justify each choice

items.title: D4 — Start the Personal Prompt Library — organising your best prompts for reuse
items.detail: Outcome: I can keep an organised library of their first 10 tested prompts

items.title: Library: 10 prompts
D1 — Hallucinations live demo and verification habits — spot-checking AI’s numbers, claims and quotes
items.detail: Outcome: I can catch and correct a hallucinated fact using a second, trusted source

items.title: D2 — Privacy & data protection — the hard rule: never paste patient, client or student information into a public AI tool; anonymising before use
items.detail: Outcome: I can anonymise a real document before using AI on it

items.title: D3 — Deepfakes, voice-cloning scams & AI content rights — spotting fake media, protecting family from scam calls, copyright and fair use of AI images
items.detail: Outcome: I can name the warning signs of a deepfake or scam call, and the basic rules for using AI-generated images

items.title: D4 — Practical Assessment 1
items.detail: Outcome: I can complete an unseen task with AI and verify the output in front of the instructor

items.title: PA1 · Library 10+ checked
D1 — Emails & letters — professional correspondence with tone control
items.detail: Outcome: I can draft a real email and adjust its tone, in English and Urdu

items.title: D2 — Reports & structured documents
items.detail: Outcome: I can turn rough notes into a structured report

items.title: D3 — CVs and Urdu/English translation control
items.detail: Outcome: I can improve a CV and check an AI translation for meaning errors

items.title: D4 — Workshop — teaching AI your own writing voice
items.detail: Outcome: I can create a reusable “my voice” instruction and test it on a new piece

items.title: D1 — Image prompting framework — subject, action, environment, camera, lighting
items.detail: Outcome: I can generate an image that matches a written brief

items.title: D2 — Editing instead of regenerating + Canva AI design
items.detail: Outcome: I can edit an image to a brief and design a poster or flyer in Canva

items.title: D3 — Intro to AI video — image-to-video with free tools
items.detail: Outcome: I can produce a 5–10 second clip from a still image

items.title: D4 — Simple edits in CapCut — finish and keep a short video clip
items.detail: Outcome: I can export a captioned short video

items.title: D1 — AI for spreadsheets & budgets — turning raw data into summaries
items.detail: Outcome: I can summarise a raw table with AI and check two of its numbers by hand

items.title: D2 — Sales and marks sheets — building simple dashboards
items.detail: Outcome: I can build a simple chart or dashboard from their own data

items.title: D3 — Verification discipline for data — why every AI number must be checked
items.detail: Outcome: I can find a planted error in an AI-generated data summary

items.title: D4 — Workshop — bring your own data, produce a real summary
items.detail: Outcome: I can produce a verified summary of their own data

items.title: D1 — NotebookLM — chat with your own PDFs and YouTube videos
items.detail: Outcome: I can get answers with citations from their own documents

items.title: D2 — Deep Research with citations
items.detail: Outcome: I can produce a short research brief and verify three of its citations

items.title: D3 — AI as a personal tutor — learning new things safely
items.detail: Outcome: I can run a study-and-quiz session with AI on a new topic

items.title: D4 — Practical Assessment 2
items.detail: Outcome: I can complete an unseen writing, visual, data or research task and verify it

items.title: PA2 · Library 25+ checked
D1 — Why build a custom assistant — from prompts to a packaged tool
items.detail: Outcome: I can identify one repeated task in their own work worth packaging

items.title: D2 — Custom GPTs & Gemini Gems — naming and instructions
items.detail: Outcome: I can write clear, tested instructions for an assistant
items.group: Week 9 — Build Your Own AI Assistant

items.title: D3 — Adding knowledge files — giving your assistant real context
items.detail: Outcome: I can add suitable, anonymised files and check that answers use them
items.group: Week 9 — Build Your Own AI Assistant

items.title: D4 — Build, test, and refine your first assistant
items.detail: Outcome: I can show a working assistant tested on five real cases

items.title: D1 — Profession track workshop — educators & business owners
items.detail: Outcome: I can apply AI to three core tasks in their own profession

items.title: D2 — Profession track workshop — office staff, students & health workers
items.detail: Outcome: I can apply AI to three core tasks in their own profession

items.title: D3 — No-code taste — live demo, building a simple app by describing it (Lovable / Bolt)
items.detail: Outcome: I can describe a one-page app and generate a working first version

items.title: D4 — Automation taste — connecting everyday tools with one simple trigger (Zapier / Make)
items.detail: Outcome: I can explain trigger → action and set up one simple automation

items.title: D1 — Capstone kickoff — choosing and scoping your real problem
items.detail: Outcome: I can write a one-paragraph problem statement with a success measure

items.title: D2 — Build day 1 — instructor-supported work time
items.detail: Outcome: I can complete a first working version of their capstone

items.title: D3 — Build day 2 — continued build + peer feedback
items.detail: Outcome: I can improve the capstone using feedback from two peers

items.title: D4 — Polish & rehearse — preparing to present
items.detail: Outcome: I can deliver a timed 15-minute rehearsal

items.title: D1 — Capstone presentations (part 1)
items.detail: Outcome: I can present and defend their capstone, including how they verified it

items.title: Capstone
D2 — Capstone presentations (part 2) + AI ethics & responsible use
items.detail: Outcome: I can explain the main ethical risks of AI in their own profession

items.title: Capstone
D3 — Final exam — practical prompting & safety scenarios
items.detail: Outcome: I can pass a practical exam on prompting, verification and safety

D4 — Graduation & certification — next steps: AI Engineer entrance assessment, Automation & Agents course
